reviewer_type: Lesson author: simulated learner/maintainer visual inspection, without student participants

findings.finding: Historical narrow vertical generic Update/Release word chips obscured motion. In the final runtime those chips are absent; all four fresh profile samples preserve readable exact Incoming identities and action markers.

Previously reported numeric clipping and owner/status ambiguity were rechecked. Final snapshots show readable decimals, full-width string registers, stationary formula text, menu selections and free/ready ownership without material collisions.

Grouped 2:4 geometry has two labeled rows of four, preserving flat values and sum 73. Calibration symmetric uses signed codes with zero point 0; asymmetric/narrow use -1. Attention retains HBM sources during SRAM copy and preserves the unchanged online-softmax mechanism.

Native Quarto Back to top button overlaps generic action/footer text in some desktop motion captures, including grad accumulation, calibration and attention. Some bottom caption/footer text falls near the screenshot edge. Operands, Incoming identities, formulas and changing values remain readable in full-size checks; endpoint captures provide settled context. This is not an obstruction of the teaching mechanism.

manual_inspection.endpoint_method: Fresh capture of every endpoint in actual final chapters. Every changed image manually inspected at native text resolution in cropped contact sheets; full figure checks as needed. Additional current images inspected even when unchanged. Remaining exact decoded-pixel matches reuse the historical explicit state-artifact inspection and PNG hash. Counts are kept in pixel_comparison; automated checks do not confer visual approval.
manual_inspection.motion_method: Fresh real Next/Pause/Finish capture for one causally meaningful base-case action per lesson/profile. All 36 in-flight PNGs inspected in native-pixel four-profile contacts, with full-size grad-accumulation, calibration and attention desktop frames plus selection narrow frame checks. Actual sampled animation times, prior committed snapshot and completed endpoint are recorded per sample. This groups repeated execute, routed-copy/gather, accumulator and affine-map primitives; it does not inspect every transition, instant or variant-case motion.
